시편-48-1.title: 시편 48장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-48-1.exegesis: 8-9. The instruction continued. throne of ... holiness-- or, "holy throne" (see on Psa 2:6 ; Psa 23:4 ).
시편-48-1.theologicalNote: 8-9. The instruction continued. throne of ... holiness-- or, "holy throne" (see on Psa 2:6 ; Psa 23:4 ).

시편-48-2.title: 시편 48장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-48-2.exegesis: PSALM 48 Psa 48:1-14 . This is a spirited Psalm and song (compare Psa 30:1 ), having probably been suggested by the same occasion as the foregoing. It sets forth the privileges and blessings of God's spiritual dominion as the terror of the wicked and joy of the righteous. 1. to be praised-- always: it is an epithet, as in Psa 18:3 . mountain of his holiness-- His Church (compare Is 2:2 , 3 ; 25:6, 7, 10 ); the sanctuary was erected first on Mount Zion, then (as the temple) on Moriah; hence the figure.

시편-48-3.title: 시편 48장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-48-3.exegesis: 2-3. situation-- literally, "elevation." joy of, &c.-- source of joy. sides of the north-- poetically for eminent, lofty, distinguished, as the ancients believed the north to be the highest part of the earth (compare Is 14:13 ).

시편-48-5.title: 시편 48장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-48-5.exegesis: 4-6. For-- The reason is given. Though the kings (perhaps of Moab and Ammon, compare Psa 83:3-5 ) combined, a conviction of God's presence with His people, evinced by the unusual courage with which the prophets (compare 2Ch 20:12-20 ) had inspired them, seized on their minds, and smitten with sudden and intense alarm, they fled astonished.

시편-48-8.title: 시편 48장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-48-8.exegesis: 7. ships of Tarshish-- as engaged in a distant and lucrative trade, the most valuable. The phrase may illustrate God's control over all material agencies, whether their literal destruction be meant or not.
시편-48-8.theologicalNote: 7. ships of Tarshish-- as engaged in a distant and lucrative trade, the most valuable. The phrase may illustrate God's control over all material agencies, whether their literal destruction be meant or not.

시편-48-9.title: 시편 48장 9절 역사문법적 주해
시편-48-9.exegesis: 8. This present experience assures of that perpetual care which God extends to His Church.
시편-48-9.theologicalNote: 8. This present experience assures of that perpetual care which God extends to His Church.

시편-48-10.title: 시편 48장 10절 역사문법적 주해
시편-48-10.exegesis: 9. thought of-- literally, "compared," or considered, in respect of former dealings. in the ... temple-- in acts of solemn worship (compare 2Ch 20:28 ).
시편-48-10.theologicalNote: 9. thought of-- literally, "compared," or considered, in respect of former dealings. in the ... temple-- in acts of solemn worship (compare 2Ch 20:28 ).

시편-48-11.title: 시편 48장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-48-11.exegesis: 10. According ... praise-- that is, As Thy perfections manifested (compare Psa 8:1 ; 20:1-7 ), demand praise, it shall be given, everywhere. thy right hand, &c.-- Thy righteous government is displayed by Thy power.
시편-48-11.theologicalNote: 10. According ... praise-- that is, As Thy perfections manifested (compare Psa 8:1 ; 20:1-7 ), demand praise, it shall be given, everywhere. thy right hand, &c.-- Thy righteous government is displayed by Thy power.

시편-48-12.title: 시편 48장 12절 역사문법적 주해
시편-48-12.exegesis: 11. the daughters, &c.-- the small towns, or the people, with the chief city, or rulers of the Church. judgments-- decisions and acts of right government.
시편-48-12.theologicalNote: 11. the daughters, &c.-- the small towns, or the people, with the chief city, or rulers of the Church. judgments-- decisions and acts of right government.

시편-48-13.title: 시편 48장 13절 역사문법적 주해
시편-48-13.exegesis: 12-14. The call to survey Zion, or the Church, as a fortified city, is designed to suggest "how well our God secures His fold." This security is perpetual, and its pledge is His guidance through this life.
